baseline_models.focus_anchor: مبلغهم من العلم; ربك هو أعلم; ضل عن سبيله / اهتدى
baseline_models.mechanism: A finite human reach is set against authoritative knowing that discriminates two trajectories relative to one way. Endpoint, disclosure, lordship, deviation, route, and gentle direction form an epistemic-jurisdiction model.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a measured endpoint makes مبلغهم the terminating horizon of human knowledge.
Knowledge as disclosure contrasts their bounded apprehension with the repeated divine أعلم.
Lordship, ownership, and authority ground the asymmetry in who can judge the route.
Deviation from aim supplies one trajectory that finite observers cannot finally classify.
The extended traversed way gives deviation and guidance a shared spatial field.
Gentle direction toward way or truth supplies the counter-trajectory to deviation.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that they know little and God knows more.
changed_reading.after: Their knowing terminates at a horizon inside which they cannot reliably classify a person's route; the Lord's knowing alone spans deviation and guidance.

baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge can be a distinguishing landmark, the way an extended route, straying disappearance from view, and guidance an intended course. The focus therefore supports a wayfinding model in which a sign-system loses the traveler but divine knowing does not.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark recasts knowledge as the landmarks by which a route is read.
Hiddenness or disappearance makes straying also a loss from the observer's field.
A traversed route organizes the marks, disappearance, and recovered direction into one mechanism.
Course and intended direction make guidance an orientation, not merely a possessed proposition.
The reached limit marks where the human map ceases to orient reliably.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is an abstract quantity and straying is only a moral label.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is a finite sign-system; God can locate trajectories that have moved beyond or vanished from its markers.

baseline_models.mechanism: مبلغ can name sufficient provision by which one gets by. Joined to knowledge as disclosure, this distinguishes a usable epistemic ration from exhaustive truth without yet resolving what ذلك points to.

activation_trace.role: Sufficient provision turns مبلغ into the ration that sustains a limited practice or life.
Disclosure supplies the epistemic substance whose sufficiency is being questioned.

changed_reading.before: مبلغ names only a quantitative ceiling on knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge may be just enough to sustain a chosen mode of life, precisely because practical utility is not exhaustive truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مبلغهم; ربك; ضل عن سبيله; اهتدى
baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching an endpoint or maturity, nurture stage by stage, the split target's nourishment and growth, and guidance as course make the two path states developmental trajectories under the Lord's full care.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and maturity make مبلغ a developmental reach rather than a frozen amount.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord the knower of formation stage by stage.
The non-dominant mapped image of nourishment and growing up intensifies the developmental mechanism.
Departure from aim supplies a trajectory that can bend during formation.
Course, conduct, and intended direction make guidedness an unfolding orientation.

changed_reading.before: Astray and guided are two static classes already visible to observers.
changed_reading.after: They are formed trajectories of growth, care, direction, and deviation whose full histories are known by the nurturing Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes authorized orientation from counterfeit sign-making: a prominent marker, distant horizon, visible signs, names as indications or brands, and absent compelling proof. This activates the focus علم as a waymark and makes divine knowing independent of socially installed labels.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark turns the focus knowledge into the marker-system being tested.
The traversed way supplies the route on which valid or counterfeit markers orient people.
A prominent landmark at the opening externalizes knowledge as a visible orientation signal.
Distant horizons spatialize the finite reach implicit in مبلغ.
A visible sign supplies the positive case of evidence that can genuinely orient.
A name as indication shows how a label can function as a pointing sign.
The split target's visible branding shows how naming can manufacture recognizability without reality.
Compelling proof supplies the authorization explicitly missing from the manufactured names.

structural_cues: 53:1-18 moves through star, horizon, sight, and signs before 53:23 turns to unsupported names.
The focus then repeats knowledge language inside a path contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies landmark, horizon, sign, name, brand, and compelling-proof images; I infer that signs orient the focus سبيل and unsupported marks counterfeit orientation; alternatively the naming passage may only expose false attribution without building a navigation model.

changed_reading.before: Their knowledge fails because it contains too few facts.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge may be a misauthorized map: labels look like waymarks, but only divine knowing distinguishes the real route from its socially branded substitutes.

context_deltas.mechanism: مبلغ becomes the reach of a transmission chain. Speech issuing from inclination contrasts with knowledge cast covertly and taught; the decisive deficit is provenance, not volume.

activation_trace.role: Conveying a message turns مبلغ into the reach achieved by a channel of transmission.
Knowledge as disclosure is the content whose source and reach are contrasted.
Articulated speech supplies the observable output whose provenance must be tested.
Inclination of the self supplies one possible source-vector for speech.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies the contrasting transmission source.
Teaching makes reception and formation of knowledge explicit rather than self-generated.

structural_cues: 53:3-5 orders speech, negated inclination, hidden communication, and teaching as a source sequence.
53:30 contrasts their علم with the Lord's repeated أعلم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, inclination, covert imparting, teaching, and message-reaching images; I infer that source controls epistemic reach; alternatively the earlier sequence may distinguish prophetic speech without defining every later human knowledge claim.

changed_reading.before: The human-divine contrast is a simple difference in how much each knows.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also concerns where knowing comes from and how far its transmission remains trustworthy: inclination-fed speech bottoms out where imparted and taught disclosure does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straight completion, inward sight, non-inclination, non-overrun, and composed bearing turn the focus path contrast into an embodied epistemic calibration. Guidance can be steadiness of perception and conduct, not merely a correct proposition.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from aim is the loss of calibration that the contextual poles specify.
The traversed way gives calibration a course on which it can hold or fail.
Calm stillness and composed bearing make guidedness an embodied stability.
Straightness and completion establish the positive calibration pole.
Inclining away from straightness supplies lateral perceptual drift.
Insight of the heart extends calibration beyond bare eyesight into discernment.
Crossing the limit in rebellion supplies the opposite failure of overrun.

structural_cues: 53:6 presents straight completion before 53:17 denies both visual inclination and excess.
53:30 later names deviation from a way and attained guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straightness, inward sight, inclination, limit-crossing, and composed-bearing images; I infer that visual discipline models epistemic and ethical method; alternatively 53:17 may describe one vision without generalizing its calibration to 53:30.

changed_reading.before: Guidance means holding the right information and straying means holding the wrong information.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be a calibrated bearing that neither drifts nor overruns, while finite knowledge fails when perception and conduct lose that balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inclination supplies force, following tracks supplies motion, conjecture supplies an unreliable trail, and will selects the lower destination. The human knowledge horizon is therefore desire-shaped and self-sealing rather than a neutral shortage.

activation_trace.role: The reached endpoint becomes the result of a motivated route rather than an accidental ceiling.
Deviation from aim names the trajectory produced by the contextual motive and method.
The extended route holds the sequence of inclination, tracking, and arrival together.
The self's inclination supplies the directional force behind selective knowing.
Tracing one mark after another supplies the method by which conjecture becomes a followed path.
Doubt and imagining supply the unstable evidence being treated as a trail.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion that conjecture cannot alter.
Will and intention expose the selected destination behind the epistemic route.
The lower and nearer world supplies the destination at which this knowledge elects to stop.

structural_cues: 53:23 and 53:28 repeat following conjecture, with desire named in 53:23.
53:29 immediately joins turning away from remembrance to willing only the lower life before 53:30 says ذلك مبلغهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inclination, track-following, imagined evidence, fixed reality, will, and the lower destination; I infer the causal arrow desire to selective following to bounded knowledge; alternatively these may be adjacent moral failures without one producing the other.

changed_reading.before: They stop knowing because evidence is unavailable to them.
changed_reading.after: They stop where their desire-led method takes them: conjecture traces a route toward the lower aim, so the epistemic boundary is partly chosen and maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus provision branch joins contextual sufficiency, beneficial life, and the lower world. Their knowledge can function well enough as subsistence for worldly aims while remaining unable to avail against truth.

activation_trace.role: Provision by which one gets by makes knowledge a ration calibrated to a limited life.
Knowledge as disclosure is the ration whose practical sufficiency is separated from truth.
Sufficiency activates the distinction between what gets by and what cannot substitute for truth.
Life as benefit and good supplies the practical economy served by the ration.
The lower world restricts the economy to its near-term horizon.

structural_cues: 53:28 denies that conjecture has any sufficiency against truth.
53:29 names only the lower life immediately before the deictic ذلك in 53:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, sufficiency, useful life, and lower-world images; I infer that ذلك reaches at least the immediately preceding lower-life orientation and that its knowledge is operationally adequate to it; alternatively the demonstrative may summarize a broader passage.

changed_reading.before: Their knowledge is simply too small to be useful.
changed_reading.after: It may be useful in a narrow sense: a ration sufficient for lower-life aims, yet categorically unable to nourish judgment beyond that economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Matched recompense, intentional action, upbringing, concealed embryonic formation, growth or purification, and self-protection make divine route-knowledge longitudinal. The Lord knows how a person was formed and moved, not merely which label the person claims now.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and maturity make the focus limit one stage in a longer formation.
Nurture and completion make lordly knowing continuous with formation and care.
The split target's nourishment and growing up keeps developmental increase live beside lordship.
Course and conduct make attained guidance the outcome of a lived trajectory.
Matching an act with its consequence turns divine knowing into accountable discrimination.
Intentional action supplies the observable movement whose route is judged.
A youth's growth and upbringing extend judgment backward through formation.
The embryo hidden in the belly supplies a stage inaccessible to self-report and public labels.
Growth and increase make self-purification a claim about development, not a fixed badge.
Purity and rectitude supply the claimed moral state that divine knowing, not self-certification, assesses.
Placing oneself under protection gives piety a practiced orientation rather than a title.

structural_cues: 53:31 follows the focus with recompense according to deeds.
53:32 runs from earthly and embryonic origin through the ban on self-purification to God's knowledge of the self-protecting person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched consequence, action, upbringing, concealed embryo, growth or purity, and self-protection; I infer that the focus classifications summarize whole trajectories; alternatively 53:31-32 may separately stress omniscience and ethics without redefining guidedness developmentally.

changed_reading.before: God knows which already formed category each person occupies.
changed_reading.after: God knows the hidden formation, practiced direction, and accountable consequences by which each trajectory becomes stray or guided, defeating self-awarded status.

context_deltas.mechanism: A digger stopped by hard ground, the unseen hidden from eyes, and the claim to see turn مبلغ into epistemic depth. Human inquiry can halt at a resistant stratum and then mistake the stopping point for sight of what lies beyond.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a limit supplies the depth at which inquiry stops.
Disclosure names what the halted inquiry has and has not uncovered.
Hiddenness keeps the unexposed trajectory below the observer's accessible surface.
Hard ground that stops digging supplies the material model for an epistemic boundary.
What is screened from eyes supplies the content lying beyond the reached stratum.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the challenged claim that the hidden layer is nevertheless visible.

structural_cues: 53:33-34 depicts turning away, giving little, and stopping at كدى.
53:35 immediately asks whether the person possesses unseen knowledge and therefore sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopped excavation, hiddenness, unseen content, and seeing; I infer a material arrow from striking bedrock to mistaking limited exposure for total vision; alternatively كدى may characterize only interrupted giving, with no epistemic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The boundary of their knowledge is an abstract line.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as epistemic bedrock: inquiry reaches a hard stop, while the Lord still knows the hidden route beneath what human sight can expose.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful movement is shown, matched with consequence, completed without deficit, and brought to the Lord's ultimate endpoint. The focus's human knowledge-limit is nested inside a teleological route whose full course and outcome divine knowing spans.

activation_trace.role: The human reached limit becomes a provisional endpoint inside a longer course.
The extended traversed way supplies the course along which effort and outcome unfold.
Intended direction makes guidedness the orientation of purposeful movement.
Intentional movement toward a sought end supplies the person's actual route contribution.
Showing and making visible moves the route from hidden effort into disclosed evidence.
Matching action with consequence connects direction to outcome.
Completion without deficit supplies the full accounting unavailable at the human horizon.
Lordship and authority identify the possessor of the final endpoint.
The goal at which a thing ends supplies the ultimate terminus beyond their مبلغ.
A number's measured extent echoes مبلغ as an amount nested within the final limit.

structural_cues: 53:39-41 orders striving, its future disclosure, and complete recompense.
53:42 closes the sequence with the endpoint to your Lord, echoing the focus's ربك and مبلغ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful motion, disclosure, matched consequence, full completion, lordship, and endpoint; I infer the arrow from lived striving to revealed and completed route-outcome; alternatively the sequence may state accountability without specifying how guidance develops.

changed_reading.before: Straying or guidance is a verdict detached from what a person does over time.
changed_reading.after: It is a directed course embodied in striving, later exposed and fully answered at the Lord's endpoint; the human knowledge-limit is only an intermediate stopping place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split target attached to ه د ي, whose branch concerns an unconfirmed suspicion rather than guidance. It remains live because that exact mapped branch is packet-authorized at focus اهتدى and explicit conjecture recurs nearby; downstream prose must present only a speculative contrast between actual guidance and felt certainty, never this branch as the lexical meaning of اهتدى.

activation_trace.role: The split target's unconfirmed inward suspicion opens a gap between attained guidance and merely seeming guided to oneself.
The same split image at the earlier arrival of الهدى keeps the activation attached to the surah's guidance lexeme.
Doubt and imagining provide an explicit nearby analogue for felt certainty without verification.

changed_reading.before: The final contrast transparently separates the astray from the genuinely guided.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowing may also expose the gap between being guided and merely carrying an unconfirmed inward picture that one is guided.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material model built from several odd but exact focus branches. It remains anchored in العلم, ربك, سبيله, and مبلغ and coherently contrasts local storage with distributed nurture; downstream prose must qualify it as hydrological analogy, not substitute water, cloud, or rain for the focus lexemes.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water materializes human knowledge as bounded storage.
A low persistent cloud supplies an overhead source for the nurture implicit in Lordship.
Abundant collected water expands lordly supply beyond the local reservoir.
Falling rain turns the way into a material distribution channel within the analogy.
Sufficient provision gives the bounded reservoir its subsistence function.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is an abstract stock measured only by quantity.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge can be imagined as a local reservoir that lets them get by, while divine knowing belongs to a wider cloud-rain economy feeding routes beyond their stored supply.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The horseman image is an idiomatic, branch-distant activation under ب ل غ, so the reading is deliberately kinetic rather than lexical. It remains anchored by focus route and direction branches and by contextual rapid travel plus desire; downstream prose should render it as an exploratory analogy for acceleration without orientation.

activation_trace.role: A horseman extending the reins to increase speed makes epistemic reach a possible accelerator.
The traversed route determines where the accelerated motion actually goes.
Intended direction distinguishes speed from genuine orientation.
Rapid forward travel activates the kinetic side of the reins image.
Inclination of the self supplies the desire-selected vector along which speed can mislead.

changed_reading.before: Greater epistemic reach necessarily moves a person closer to guidance.
changed_reading.after: Finite knowledge can act like reins that increase speed along a desire-selected route, so epistemic reach may intensify rather than cure straying.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ضل is normally carried as moral or path deviation, while its focus inventory also permits disappearance. Concealed embryo, hidden interior, and unseen content keep the overlay contextually anchored; downstream prose should retain moral deviation as the primary coexistive reading while noting that God knows route-histories lost to human sight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بمن ضل عن سبيله beside أعلم

activation_trace.role: Disappearance or absorption lets the straying trajectory become inaccessible to human observation.
Knowledge as disclosure makes divine awareness span what has disappeared from view.
The embryo concealed in the belly supplies a route-history hidden from public classification.
The concealed interior broadens hiddenness from location to inward history.
What is screened from eyes confirms the limit of human access to the disappeared trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Who strayed is a fully visible moral class that observers can identify from the outside.
changed_reading.after: Alongside moral deviation, straying can carry a hidden-history overlay: God knows trajectories that have disappeared into interiors and origins inaccessible to human sight.

strongest_changes: The finite knowledge-limit became desire-shaped and provenance-sensitive rather than merely quantitative.
Names and visible marks became a counterfeit wayfinding system unless authorized by compelling proof.
Divine knowledge of straying and guidance became longitudinal, spanning hidden formation, practiced effort, disclosed outcome, and the final endpoint.
مبلغ retained coexisting material readings as practical ration and epistemic bedrock, with acceleration, hydrology, and split-root suspicion preserved as contained outliers.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots first formed a coherent horizon-and-navigation field; context then changed its causal structure through transmission, motive, formation, accountability, and teleology without collapsing the provision, material, or split-root activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact reach of the demonstrative ذلك remains open even though adjacency strongly activates the lower-life reading.
The bedrock, hydrology, and reins models are branch-grounded analogies, not secure lexical substitutions.
The non-dominant ه د د and ر ب و targets remain formally distant and require explicit containment.
Hiddenness can coexist with moral deviation in ضل, but should not erase the primary route-error sense.
